AC amendment: Handle fast-CI auto-merge race in Phase 1b polling

During the mergeStateStatus poll loop (up to 60s), the conforming PR may auto-merge before a BLOCKED state is observed. Amend T1 to:
(a) During the poll loop, if 'state=MERGED' is returned from gh pr view --json state, emit _skip 'test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed' with log 'PR auto-merged before BLOCKED window observed — Phase 1b skipped' and break out of the poll loop immediately.
(b) After Phase 1b completes, check whether the conforming PR is still open before proceeding to the existing _poll_checks call. If the PR is already in MERGED state (auto-merged during Phase 1b), skip _poll_checks and test_conforming_pr_merges and emit _skip for those assertions (the auto-merge satisfies the intent).

Additional AC verify:
- [ ] poll loop handles state=MERGED early exit (does not hang after PR merges)
  Verify: grep -qE 'state.*MERGED|MERGED.*state' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
